mapper.select: select p.id as id, p.is_active as isActive, p.address as address, p.description as description, p.is_available as isAvailable, p.property_type as propertyType, p.rent_price as rentPrice, p.room_count as roomCount, p.title as roomTitle, u.full_name as ownerName, p.owner_id as ownerid, pa.amenity as amenity_amenities, pi.image_url as image_url from property p left join property_amenities pa on p.id = pa.property_id left join users u on p.owner_id = u.id left join property_image pi on p.id = pi.property_id where p.id = #{propertyId};
